subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicit persistent webhook hook sessions through the open `sessionMode` PR, keep `/hooks/agent` permanently isolated, or choose a different narrower API?
rationale: This changes a trusted external hook surface and session-state security boundary, so automation should not choose the product/security contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review linked sessionMode PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75918 as the canonical implementation path because it keeps `isolated` as the default and makes persistent reuse explicit.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated
options.body: Decline persistent hook sessions and update docs/API wording so callers know stable `sessionKey` is routing metadata, not transcript continuity for hook-agent runs.

options.title: Request a narrower API
options.body: Ask for a smaller hook-only persistence contract if maintainers do not want the broader config, mapping, transform, and direct-payload surface in the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Review linked sessionMode PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75918 as the canonical implementation path because it keeps `isolated` as the default and makes persistent reuse explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter provided the latest maintainer cleanup direction and has recent adjacent session and hook history.
